heading: Powers
lead: The corporation has only the powers provided in its bylaws and articles of incorporation filed in each State in which it is incorporated.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 2110636:2402.June 12, 1984, Pub. L. 98–314, § 2, 98 Stat. 237. The words “and subject to the laws of such State or States” are omitted as unnecessary.
